description: As you gaze into the seemingly infinite depths of this portable hole in reality, a phrase from a time forever gone echoes in your mind.  "There are two things that are infinite: the universe and human kleptomania."
Several heavy frames retrofitted to be installed together which are outfitted with tie-downs and attachment points gallore for carrying an extended amount of cargo.
A household refrigerator with impressive capacity.  Its power connection has been refurbished, and it can be mounted onto a vehicle to draw from its power.

This refurbished refrigerator has been stripped of much of its internal components and converted to run at a much lower temperature, causing it to serve as a freezer for more power.  Like its predecessor, it runs on vehicle power.
